Reconcile watershed labels with off-mask suitable cells

Source: R/fn_patches.R
merge_offmask.Rd

Post-watershed assembly: take the raw watershed segmentation seg and the suitability mask, drop the watershed's zero/negative background, and give an identity to suitable cells the watershed left unlabelled (those that drained off-mask, i.e. small patches with no interior pit) via a rook's-case (4-connected) component pass. Those fallback component ids are shifted above the maximum watershed label so the two id spaces never collide, then layered under the watershed labels with terra::cover and clipped back to the mask.

Usage

merge_offmask(seg, mask)

Arguments

seg

A SpatRaster of raw watershed segment labels (0/negative = background).

mask

A logical SpatRaster: TRUE on suitable cells.

Value

A SpatRaster of integer patch ids (NA off-mask), before the sliver filter.

See also

delineate_patches, drop_slivers
